name: Buyer security questionnaire answers
summary: When a buyer sends a security questionnaire, your sales owner gets a draft answer matrix: each question beside the evidence your security owner supplied, its date, its limits and a named reviewer, with stale, partial and unverifiable answers marked.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of answering a buyer's security questionnaire, written from how that work is done: evidence supplied by the security owner, marks for stale, partial and unverifiable answers, and a named reviewer for each answer.
